ctx.x: Alfred Lion? Well, Alfred Lion again was part of the aficionado scene. Alfred Ljon and Frank Wolff. They were both also in that Village scene, as was in part the Turkish ambassador's Ertegun sons, You could see their faces now and then.
But they were interested, very interested. And it was like a bunch.
